level_one.title: Colossal Totem
level_one.description: Reactivate Earthbind Totem to move an existing totem to a new location. This can be used once per cast.  Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's area and duration by 50%, and Health by 25%.

level_four.title: Earthliving Enchant
level_four.description: When Chain Heal heals a Hero below 50% Health, they are healed an additional 160 (+4% per level) Health over 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Grounded Totem
level_seven.description: Enemy Heroes in Earthbind Totem's area also have their Attack Speed Slowed by 15% and their Spell Power reduced by 15%.  Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's cast range by 45%.

level_ten.title: Ancestral Healing
level_ten.description: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180 (+4% per level) Health.

level_thirteen.title: Tidal Waves
level_thirteen.description: Reduces Chain Heal's cooldown by 1 second for each Hero healed, and reduces its Mana cost from 60 to 40.

level_sixteen.title: Earthgrasp Totem
level_sixteen.description: When Earthbind Totem is first cast, it deals 90 (+4% per level) damage and Slows nearby enemies by 90% for 1 second.

level_twenty.title: Farseer's Blessing
level_twenty.description: After 1.5 seconds, Ancestral Healing is cast a second time on the same target. Allies near the target are healed for 590 (+4% per level).

level_one.title: Adrenaline Stimpack
level_one.description: Passive: While over 80% Health, gain 20% bonus Attack Speed and 10% bonus Movement Speed.  Activate to gain 85% Attack Speed and 25% Movement Speed for 5 seconds.

level_four.title: Incinerator Gauntlets
level_four.description: Increase Basic Attack area by 15%, and Basic Attack damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters by 40%.

level_seven.title: Nanomachine Coating
level_seven.description: Enemies standing in Oil Spills and Ignited Oil Spills have their Attack Speed reduced by 35% for 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Bunker Drop
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, deploy and enter a Bunker with 1435 (+4% per level) Health. Blaze and his allies can enter and exit the Bunker at will. While in the Bunker, occupants gain access to Flamethrower, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line.  Exiting the Bunker grants 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Bunkers last 10 seconds, or until destroyed.

level_thirteen.title: Collision Course
level_thirteen.description: Jet Propulsion's collision deals 260 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit.

level_sixteen.title: Thermal Protection
level_sixteen.description: Each enemy hit by Jet Propulsion grants 10 Armor for 3 seconds and reduces its cooldown by 1.25 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Burn Notice
level_twenty.description: Basic Attacks Slow enemies by 5% and deal an additional 18 (+4% per level) damage over 2.5 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.

level_one.title: Timewalker's Pursuit
level_one.description: Gain 15% Spell Power and reduce the arming time of Time Traps by 0.75 seconds. Activate to reveal the targeted area for 4 seconds. Enemies seen are revealed for 4 seconds.

level_four.title: Time Troubles
level_four.description: After its Time Stop ends, enemies affected by Time Trap lose 15 Armor for 3 seconds and allies gain 30 Armor for 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: A Proper Greeting
level_seven.description: Damaging a Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed enemy Hero grants 20% additional damage for 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Slowing Sands
level_ten.description: Summon a sand vortex that Slows enemies by 10% every 0.25 seconds, up to 70%.

level_thirteen.title: Time Out
level_thirteen.description: Activate to place Chromie in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for up to 5 seconds. Can be reactivated to end the effect early.

level_sixteen.title: Fast Forward
level_sixteen.description: If Chromie's primary Sand Blast travels at least 50% of its base distance and hits a Hero, its cooldown is reduced to 0.5 seconds and it refunds 10 Mana.

level_twenty.title: Unravelling
level_twenty.description: Every 0.25 seconds, enemy Heroes Slowed by Slowing Sands have their Spell Armor reduced by 10 up to 50.  Passive: Increase Slowing Sands cast range by 50%, and Slowing Sands persists for 5 seconds after it is cancelled.

level_one.title: Unrelenting Torment
level_one.description: Increase the damage of Shadow Dagger by 20% and increase its duration by 1 second.

level_four.title: Haunting Arrows
level_four.description: Black Arrows can now be activated to cause all Basic Attacks and Abilities to Stun Minions and Structures for 3 seconds. Lasts for 10 seconds. Basic Attacks against Structures reduce this cooldown by 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: Lost Soul
level_seven.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes and Structures with 3 stacks of Black Arrows reduce the cooldown of Shadow Dagger by 0.75 seconds, doubled against Heroes.

level_ten.title: Mind Control
level_ten.description: After 0.25 seconds, fire a missile that Mind Controls the first enemy Hero hit. Heroes hit are Silenced, Slowed by 30%, have 3 stacks of Black Arrows applied to them, and are forced to walk towards Sylvanas for 1.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Remorseless
level_thirteen.description: Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Black Arrows shoot an untalented shot of Withering Fire. This shot of Withering Fire applies Black Arrows.  Increase Sylvanas's Basic Attack range by 1.

level_sixteen.title: Evasive Fire
level_sixteen.description: Hitting an enemy with Withering Fire grants 6% Movement Speed for 2 seconds, up to 30%. Basic Attacks refresh this duration.

level_twenty.title: Dark Lady's Call
level_twenty.description: Heroes hit by Mind Control have their vision radius greatly reduced for 5 seconds. Mind Control's cooldown is reduced by 25 seconds.

level_one.title: Ardent Restoration
level_one.description: Dealing damage to a Hero heals Tyrael for 20 (+4% per level) Health over 5 seconds. Dealing damage resets this timer, and the heal amount stacks up to 8 times.  Quest: Every Regeneration Globe gathered increases this heal amount by 1%.

level_four.title: Reciprocate
level_four.description: When Tyrael's Shield from Righteousness expires or is destroyed, it deals 170 (+4% per level) damage to nearby Heroes and Summons.  For each enemy Hero damaged by Reciprocate or El'Druin's Might, Tyrael heals for 3% of his maximum Health.

level_seven.title: Burning Halo
level_seven.description: Both Tyrael and El'druin deal 12 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Teleporting increases this damage from Tyrael by 125% for 2 seconds.

level_ten.title: Judgment
level_ten.description: After 0.75 seconds, charge an enemy Hero, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds. Nearby enemies are knocked away and take 75 (+4% per level) damage.

level_thirteen.title: Holy Ground
level_thirteen.description: Create a ring for 3 seconds that blocks enemies from entering the area teleported to using El'druin's Might.

level_sixteen.title: Bound by Law
level_sixteen.description: El'Druin's Might's Slow is increased to 65% for 1 second, decaying to 30% over the remaining duration.

level_twenty.title: Angel of Justice
level_twenty.description: Increases the cast range of Judgment by 50%, and reduces the cooldown by 40 seconds.

level_one.title: Power Word: Shield
level_one.description: While Divine Star is traveling out, allies in its path gain a Shield that absorbs 128 (+4% per level) damage for 4 seconds.  If Divine Star hits an enemy Hero, Anduin gains a Shield that absorbs 185 (+4% per level) damage for 4 seconds.

level_four.title: Moral Compass
level_four.description: Divine Star fires Basic Attacks at Heroes close to its apex.  Passive: Increase Attack Range by 1.1.

level_seven.title: Desperate Prayer
level_seven.description: Activate to instantly heal an allied Hero for 375 (+4% per level), but kneel for 2 seconds, unable to act.

level_ten.title: Lightbomb
level_ten.description: Imbue an allied Hero with the Light. After 1.5 seconds, it explodes, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds.  The target gains a Shield that absorbs 165 (+4% per level) damage per enemy Hero hit. Lasts for 5 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Speed of the Pious
level_thirteen.description: While Divine Star is traveling, gain 30% Movement Speed. Each allied Hero healed by Divine Star on its return to Anduin reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

level_sixteen.title: Holy Nova
level_sixteen.description: After Anduin catches Divine Star, it explodes, healing nearby allied Heroes for 105 (+4% per level) and damaging enemies for 150 (+4% per level).

level_twenty.title: Inner Fire
level_twenty.description: The target of Light Bomb gains 40% Move Speed and 50 Armor for 3 seconds.

level_one.title: Heat Transfer
level_one.description: Basic Attacks against Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed Heroes deal 33% more damage. Each time Mei Stuns or Slows an enemy Hero she heals for 16 (+4% per level) Health.

level_four.title: Crystallize
level_four.description: Reduce the cooldown of Cryo-Freeze by 10 seconds. Mei gains 40 Spell Armor while Cryo-Freeze is active and for 1 second after.

level_seven.title: Induce Hibernation
level_seven.description: Blizzard reduces the damage dealt by enemy Heroes inside of its area by 40%.  When Blizzard ends, enemy Heroes still within its area gain this effect for an additional 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Avalanche
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, roll a massive snowball that consumes enemy Heroes in its path. At the end of its path, the snowball crumbles, releasing the consumed Heroes, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds per Hero consumed.

level_thirteen.title: Cooling Servos
level_thirteen.description: While Cryo-Freeze is active, Mei's Basic Ability cooldowns recover 200% faster.  Passive: Basic Attacks Slow by 20% for 1.5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Acclimation
level_sixteen.description: Each time Mei Stuns or Slows an enemy Hero, the damage she deals and healing she receives is increased by 1%, stacking up to 20 times. While at maximum stacks, Mei also gains 10 Armor. Lasts 8 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Flash Freeze
level_twenty.description: When Mei takes fatal damage she instantly gains Cryo-Freeze. This effect has a 180 second cooldown.

level_one.title: Pressurized Glands
level_one.description: Increases the range of Symbiote's Spike Burst by 25% and decreases the cooldown by 1 second.

level_four.title: Needlespine
level_four.description: Increases the damage and range of Symbiote's Stab by 20%.

level_seven.title: Calldown: MULE
level_seven.description: Activate to calldown a Mule that repairs Structures, one at a time, near target point for 40 seconds, healing for 90 Health every 1 second.

level_ten.title: Ultimate Evolution
level_ten.description: Clone target allied Hero and control it for 20 seconds. Abathur has perfected the clone, granting it 20% Spell Power, 20% bonus Attack Damage, and 10% bonus Movement Speed. Cannot use their Heroic Ability.

level_thirteen.title: Spatial Efficiency
level_thirteen.description: Symbiote's Stab gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by .5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Envenomed Spikes
level_sixteen.description: Abathur's Symbiote's Spike Burst also Slows enemy Movement Speed by 40% for 2 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Hivemind
level_twenty.description: Symbiote creates an additional Symbiote on a nearby allied Hero.  This Symbiote mimics the commands of the first, but does half damage and Shielding.

level_one.title: Enhanced Agility
level_one.description: Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus now lasts for 4 seconds after leaving a bush.  Repeatable Quest: Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases the Movement Speed bonus of Brushstalker by 2%, up to 20%.

level_four.title: One-Who-Collects
level_four.description: Increases Essence collected from Minions by 50%. Dark Swarm deals 40% more damage to Mercenaries.

level_seven.title: Feeding Frenzy
level_seven.description: Increase Drag's duration by 0.5 seconds.  Gambit: Basic Attacks reduce Drag's cooldown by 1.5 seconds. Every death reduces this cooldown reduction by 0.25 seconds, up to 3 times.

level_ten.title: Isolation
level_ten.description: Launch biomass that hits the first enemy Hero dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage, revealing, Silencing, and Slowing them 30% for 3 seconds. Additionally, their vision radius is greatly reduced for 6 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Ferocious Stalker
level_thirteen.description: Dark Swarm Slows enemy Heroes by 15% for 0.75 seconds and deals 50% more damage while Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus is active.

level_sixteen.title: Pack Leader
level_sixteen.description: Dehaka gains 40 Armor and 15% increased Attack Speed while in a bush and for 4 seconds after leaving.

level_twenty.title: Apex Predator
level_twenty.description: Reduces Brushstalker's cooldown by 120 seconds and the cast time by 0.5 seconds.

level_one.title: Gathering Storm
level_one.description: Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Hammerang. Restore 6 Mana for each Hero hit. Upon dying, Lose 8 stacks.  Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, Hammerang permanently deals 30% more damage.  Reward: After hitting 80 Heroes, Hammerang permanently deals an additional 50% damage.  Mythic Reward: After hitting 150 Heroes, Hammerang permanently deals an additional 70% damage.

level_four.title: Updraft
level_four.description: Increases Barrel Roll's range by 40% and Shield amount by 70%, and its Shield now lasts indefinitely.

level_seven.title: BOOMerang
level_seven.description: Hammerang's explosion deals 100% additional damage, and hitting enemy Heroes reduces their Spell Armor by 15 for 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Hinterland Blast
level_ten.description: After 1 second, deal 475 (+4.75% per level) damage to enemies within a long line. The cooldown is reduced by 30 seconds for every enemy Hero hit.

level_thirteen.title: Flow Rider
level_thirteen.description: While Tailwind is active, Falstad's Basic Abilities recharge 100% faster.

level_sixteen.title: Crippling Hammer
level_sixteen.description: Increase Hammerang's Slow from 25% to 50%, and Hammerang's explosion also Slows.

level_twenty.title: Call of the Wildhammer
level_twenty.description: Hinterland Blast has double the range and deals 25% more damage.
